records.jp: お腹が空いたなーってことで、<CR>作業室にきてみたけど……
records.en_original: My legs kind of just carried me to the work room when I started feeling hungry, but...
records.en_auxiliary: My legs kind of just carried me to the work room when I started feeling hungry, but...
records.en: I was hungry,<CR>so I came to the work room, but...

records.jp: きらら、料理って出来るの？
records.en_original: Kirara, can you cook?
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara, can you cook?
records.en: Kirara, can you cook?

records.jp: 正直、わからない
records.en_original: Honestly, I have no idea.
records.en_auxiliary: Honestly, I have no idea.
records.en: Honestly, I have no idea.

records.jp: わからない？
records.en_original: You don't know?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't know?
records.en: You don't know?

records.jp: 一人で作ったことがないから、わからない。<CR>でも、きららになら出来るような気がする
records.en_original: I've never cooked on my own before, so I can't say for sure. However, something tells me I'd be good at it.
records.en_auxiliary: I've never cooked on my own before, so I can't say for sure. However, something tells me I'd be good at it.
records.en: Kirara has never cooked by herself before, so she doesn't know.<CR>But Kirara feels like she could do it.

records.jp: あ、なんか今フラグ立った
records.en_original: I've got a bad feeling about this...
records.en_auxiliary: I've got a bad feeling about this...
records.en: Ah, I think you just raised a flag.

records.jp: 愛央、何か食べたいもの言ってみて
records.en_original: Is there anything you'd like to eat, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything you'd like to eat, Ao?
records.en: Is there anything you'd like to eat, Ao?

records.jp: うーん……
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: ビーフストロガノフかな
records.en_original: Beef stroganoff.
records.en_auxiliary: Beef stroganoff.
records.en: Beef stroganoff.

records.jp: ビーフストロガノフ……
records.en_original: Beef...stroganoff...
records.en_auxiliary: Beef...stroganoff...
records.en: Beef...stroganoff...

records.jp: なんて、冗談、冗談！<CR>ちょっと言ってみたかっただけだし！
records.en_original: Just kidding! I just wanted to see what your reaction would be!
records.en_auxiliary: Just kidding! I just wanted to see what your reaction would be!
records.en: Just kidding, just kidding!<CR>I only wanted to say it!

records.jp: ロシアの煮込み料理か……<CR>だいたいのイメージは出来た
records.en_original: You mean the Russian sauteed beef dish, correct? I think I have an idea of what I need to do...
records.en_auxiliary: You mean the Russian sauteed beef dish, correct? I think I have an idea of what I need to do...
records.en: A Russian stew...<CR>Kirara has a general idea of what it should be.

records.jp: 唐揚げかな
records.en_original: Fried chicken.
records.en_auxiliary: Fried chicken.
records.en: Karaage.

records.jp: でも、唐揚げって初心者には難しいよね<CR>やっぱ、別のものにしよっか
records.en_original: Ah, I guess that might be hard for a beginner, huh? Maybe I'll think of something else.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, I guess that might be hard for a beginner, huh? Maybe I'll think of something else.
records.en: But karaage is difficult for a beginner, right?<CR>Maybe I should choose something else.

records.jp: 問題ない。<CR>きららは、愛央が食べたいものを作ると決めた
records.en_original: No need to worry. I already decided that I would make whatever you asked for.
records.en_auxiliary: No need to worry. I already decided that I would make whatever you asked for.
records.en: No need to worry.<CR>Kirara has decided to make whatever you want to eat, Ao.

records.jp: え、本当に作る気？
records.en_original: No way, you're actually going to try?
records.en_auxiliary: No way, you're actually going to try?
records.en: No way, you're actually going to try?

records.jp: もっと簡単そうな、目玉焼きとか……<CR>いや、いっそ卵かけご飯とか！
records.en_original: Why don't you start with something easier? Like a fried egg or something?
records.en_auxiliary: Why don't you start with something easier? Like a fried egg or something?
records.en: Something easier, like a fried egg...<CR>No, even tamago kake gohan!

records.jp: 案ずるより産むが易し……
records.en_original: You never know if you don't try.
records.en_auxiliary: You never know if you don't try.
records.en: Doing it is easier than worrying about it...

records.jp: 心配はいらない、きららには神様がついてる
records.en_original: Do not worry. The Divine is with me.
records.en_auxiliary: Do not worry. The Divine is with me.
records.en: There is no need to worry. The Divine is with Kirara.

records.jp: でも、ここに来てから神様の声聞こえないって<CR>言ってたよね？
records.en_original: But didn't you say you can't hear them anymore?
records.en_auxiliary: But didn't you say you can't hear them anymore?
records.en: But you said you haven't heard the Divine's voice since coming here,<CR>right?

records.jp: 愛央は、きららが信用できない？
records.en_original: ...Do you not trust me, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Do you not trust me, Ao?
records.en: ...Don't you trust Kirara, Ao?

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: ちょっとだけ不安……かな？
records.en_original: I'm...a bit worried.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...a bit worried.
records.en: I'm...a bit worried.

records.jp: なんで？
records.en_original: Why?
records.en_auxiliary: Why?
records.en: Why?

records.jp: だって、きららが料理してるとこ<CR>見たことないし
records.en_original: Well, for starters, I've never seen you cook...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, for starters, I've never seen you cook...
records.en: Well, for starters,<CR>I've never seen you cook...

records.jp: なるほど、たしかに一理ある。<CR>それなら、その目で確かめてもらえばいい
records.en_original: Yes, you have a point... Very well, make sure you get a good look at this.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, you have a point... Very well, make sure you get a good look at this.
records.en: I see. You do have a point.<CR>Then you can confirm it with your own eyes.

records.jp: き、きららのことは、信用してるよ！
records.en_original: O-of course I believe in you!
records.en_auxiliary: O-of course I believe in you!
records.en: O-of course I believe in you!

records.jp: 愛央、目が泳いでる
records.en_original: Your eyes say otherwise.
records.en_auxiliary: Your eyes say otherwise.
records.en: Your eyes say otherwise.

records.jp: あはは……
records.en_original: Ahaha...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha...
records.en: Ahaha...

records.jp: まあ、いい。<CR>実際に作って見せれば良いだけ
records.en_original: No matter. Showing you will be the simplest solution.
records.en_auxiliary: No matter. Showing you will be the simplest solution.
records.en: No matter.<CR>Kirara only needs to show you by actually making it.

records.jp: （きららに任せて、本当に大丈夫かな？）
records.en_original: (I hope she knows what she's doing...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I hope she knows what she's doing...)
records.en: (Is it really safe to leave this to Kirara...?)

records.jp: ……なんだこれは
records.en_original: What is this...?
records.en_auxiliary: What is this...?
records.en: What is this...?

records.jp: どうみても、ダークマターだね
records.en_original: This is...food?
records.en_auxiliary: This is...food?
records.en: No matter how I look at it, that's dark matter.

records.jp: むう……どうしてこうなった。<CR>きららのイメージは完璧だったのに……
records.en_original: Hmph... I don't know what happened. I had the dish perfectly visualized in my mind...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph... I don't know what happened. I had the dish perfectly visualized in my mind...
records.en: Hmph... How did this happen?<CR>Kirara's mental image was perfect...

records.jp: 愛央が美味しいって言う姿まで見えたのに……
records.en_original: I was so excited to hear you enjoy it...
records.en_auxiliary: I was so excited to hear you enjoy it...
records.en: Kirara could even see you saying how delicious it was...

records.en_original: (Sounds like she was really looking forward to me enjoying it...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Sounds like she was really looking forward to me enjoying it...)
records.en: (My form...?)

records.jp: さずかにこれは食べられないけど……<CR>きららの気持ちはすごく嬉しいよ
records.en_original: This may be totally inedible, but I really appreciate it, Kirara.
records.en_auxiliary: This may be totally inedible, but I really appreciate it, Kirara.
records.en: I can't possibly eat this, but... I'm really<CR>happy about how you feel, Kirara.

records.jp: きららの？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: Kirara's?

records.jp: 私のためにって頑張ってくれたんでしょ？
records.en_original: Well, you put in all that effort for my sake, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, you put in all that effort for my sake, right?
records.en: Well, you put in all that effort for my sake, right?

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Yes.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yes.
records.en: ...Yes.

records.jp: ありがとね！
records.en_original: So I wanted to thank you!
records.en_auxiliary: So I wanted to thank you!
records.en: Thanks!

records.jp: でも、これじゃあ空腹は満たされない
records.en_original: But...you're still hungry, aren't you?
records.en_auxiliary: But...you're still hungry, aren't you?
records.en: But...you're still hungry, aren't you?

records.jp: たしかに……どうしようか
records.en_original: Oh, yeah... What to do...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, yeah... What to do...
records.en: Oh, yeah... What to do...

records.jp: こうなったら、あれしかない
records.en_original: I believe there's only one solution.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe there's only one solution.
records.en: I believe there's only one solution.

records.jp: 困った時の詩帆頼み、なのだ
records.en_original: It's time to bring in the big guns. Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: It's time to bring in the big guns. Shiho.
records.en: When in trouble, rely on Shiho. That is the answer.

records.jp: 折角、きららが作ってくれたから<CR>一口ぐらいは食べてみようかな……
records.en_original: You worked so hard to make this for me, I should at least have a taste.
records.en_auxiliary: You worked so hard to make this for me, I should at least have a taste.
records.en: Since Kirara went to all this trouble to make it,<CR>maybe I should at least try one bite...

records.jp: 愛央が食べるなら、きららも食べる
records.en_original: If you're eating some, then I shall too.
records.en_auxiliary: If you're eating some, then I shall too.
records.en: If you're eating it, Ao, then Kirara will too.

records.jp: よし、いくか！<CR>死なば諸共！
records.en_original: All right, Let's do this! We can do this together!
records.en_auxiliary: All right, Let's do this! We can do this together!
records.en: All right, here goes!<CR>If we die, we die together!

records.jp: せーの……！
records.en_original: Three, two, one...
records.en_auxiliary: Three, two, one...
records.en: Ready, set...!

records.jp: ……きらら、もう一人で料理しちゃダメ
records.en_original: Kirara... Never cook on your own again.
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara... Never cook on your own again.
records.en: Kirara... Never cook on your own again.

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Agreed...
records.en_auxiliary: Agreed...
records.en: Agreed...

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
